description: State Representative Fred Atchley (R-Sevierville) has received the endorsement of the Tennessee Professional Fire Fighters Association for his reelection campaign to the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 12. The TPFFA represents 35 affiliates and approximately 7,100 active and retired firefighters, fire prevention professionals, fire instructors, EMS personnel, and emergency services workers across the state of Tennessee. The organization has served Tennessee's fire service community
paid_for_by: Paid for by Fred Atchley for State Representative, Phil Whaley, Treasurer
title: State Rep. Fred Atchley Receives Endorsement from Tennessee Professional Fire Fighters Association
